thread:
Maya: Pushed a quick mock — sidecar stepper that slides in from the right for first-run. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/onboard-sidecar.png :eyes:
Jon: Love the compactness. Concern: does it hide too much of the console at small widths?
Sam: Mobile view needs to be considered — sidecar might cover the whole screen, which is ok if modal semantics are used.
Harper: Copy thought: current CTA reads 'Start quickstart' which feels vague. Suggest: 'Run sample project' or 'Try a sample app'
Maya: Good call. New phrasing options in the mock: "Run sample project" | "Try demo app" | "Launch quickstart". Which resonates?
Akira: "Run sample project" is explicit about action. Also, add a small helper tooltip for permission scopes when they click the demo repo link.
Jon: Accessibility nit: color of the progress indicator (light blue) doesn't meet 4.5:1 on dark mode. Need higher contrast or outline.
Harper: Keyboard flow: Tab should focus the stepper close button, then primary CTA, then secondary. Right now the order is CTA -> close -> settings, which is confusing.
Maya: Noted — will change DOM order. Also adding aria-live region announcing step changes for screen readers.
Sam: Can we keep the onboarding checklist persistent in the console header after dismiss? Some folks rely on it for later setup steps. Could be a small badge.
Maya: Proposal: if dismissed, show a condensed 'Setup checklist' chip in the header with unread count. Click reopens the sidecar. Thoughts?
Jon: +1 to the chip. But include an explicit "Don't show again" in the sidecar with an accessible toggle and explain that they can re-open from the header.
Harper: Copy tweak for checklist items — verbs should be present tense: "Connect repo" -> "Connect your repo"; make them actionable.
Akira: Telemetry question: are we tracking which sample project users pick? We should avoid PII, just sample-id and whether they completed. Also include a consent screen if sending usage to analytics outside org.
Maya: Yes we will only emit sample-id + event. I'll add the analytics opt-in copy under a disclosure: "Help us improve onboarding (anonymous usage data)" with a default opt-in for new orgs.
Sam: Default opt-in feels aggressive. Legal asked for default-off for EU orgs. Can we detect region and default accordingly?
Maya: We'll implement region-aware default: EU => opt-out by default, others => opt-in. I'll surface that in the copy.
Jon: Microcopy for skip: current 'Skip for now' confused testers who thought it completed setup. Maybe 'Snooze setup' or 'Close and continue' is clearer.
Harper: Also add a confirmation toast when they snooze that says "Setup snoozed — reopen via Setup chip". Include an undo action in the toast.
Akira: UI performance: sidecar open animation should be reduced to 160ms. Current mock is 300ms and feels sluggish.
Maya: Will update animation timing. Also adding a tiny code snippet in the step for 'Add API key' so they can copy paste: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ping```
Jon: Love the inline copy button on that code block. Ensure the copy button has aria-label "Copy curl command".
Harper: For sample projects list, default sort should be 'recommended' then 'language' filter. Right now it's alphabetical which buries the simple 'hello-world' sample.
Maya: Reordering to recommended by default. We'll surface language filters as pills on top.
Akira: QA note: test with screen reader (NVDA/VoiceOver) and keyboard-only — particularly the repo picker and code copy flow.
console-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled 2027-04-12 16:00 UTC. Attaching latest Figma: https://figma.redwood/onboard/sidecar-v3
Maya: Thanks — I'll push updated mock and accessibility checklist before the review. :thumbsup:
Jon: Quick follow-up: can we A/B test banner vs sidecar on 20% of new orgs to measure completion rate?
Maya: Yes, adding experiment flag and metric definitions to the ticket.
Sam: One last UX ask — add a "why this matter" microcopy under the main title: "Finish setup to reduce latency and enable cheaper caching" (or something less technical).
Harper: Suggest "Complete setup to unlock recommendations and optimize cost" — focuses on user benefit.
Maya: Final action items: adjust CTA copy to 'Run sample project', fix keyboard order, increase contrast, update animation timing, add header chip after dismiss, region-aware analytics default, add undo toast. I'll update the ticket with checklist and PR link. :white_check_mark:
